page_title: ESP 1-0 GET | Espanyol v Getafe 18/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Ricardo De Burgos is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Walid Cheddira (Espanyol) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
90+3' David Soria (Getafe) sends in a cross from a long-range free kick. However, his effort lacks accuracy and the ball sails off the pitch.
90+1' Exposito (Espanyol) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to substitute Jofre and he is replaced by Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol).
90' Roberto Fernandez Jaen goes off the pitch and Walid Cheddira (Espanyol) comes on.
87' Luis Milla (Getafe) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.

87' Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Ricardo De Burgos saw the whole situation. Getafe win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
86' Luis Milla (Getafe) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Joan Garcia.
84' Fernando Calero (Espanyol) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
84' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
82' The referee allows time for a substitution. Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez will be replaced by Juan Bernat (Getafe).
81' Alvaro Rodriguez comes off the pitch to be replaced by Borja Mayoral (Getafe).
81' A substitution has been made. Ramon Terrats goes off and Carles Perez (Getafe) comes on.
80' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to make a change. Alex Kral (Espanyol) replaces Pol Lozano.
80' The substitution is prepared. Pere Milla (Espanyol) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Antoniu Roca.
76' Exposito (Espanyol) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
75' Jofre (Espanyol) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Espanyol.
74' Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
74' The linesman makes the right call and Getafe will have a corner.
73' What was Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
73' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just over the bar.
72' Jose Bordalas Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Coba Gomez da Costa will be replaced by Juanmi (Getafe).
72' It is time for a substitution. Fernando Calero (Espanyol) is on for Marash Kumbulla.
68' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) leans back and sends a volley soaring over the bar from inside the box.
68' Espanyol take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
68' The free kick from long range, taken by Espanyol, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
66' 3:7 – the corner kicks stats.

64' Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
63' We are about to witness a corner kick, another promising situation.
63' Exposito (Espanyol) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top left corner only for David Soria to dive and make a save.
60' The ref signals that VAR has overturned that yellow card and upgraded it to a straight red for Christantus Uche (Getafe). He’s got to go!

59' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Christantus Uche (Getafe), but referee Ricardo De Burgos must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
58' Christantus Uche (Getafe) takes out his opponent with a horrific tackle and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
57' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
57' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
53' Flag up against Ramon Terrats (Getafe). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.

50' A close-range header from Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) went to the top left corner. Joan Garcia makes sure the score remains the same as he pulls off an exquisite save and deflects the ball onto the post.

49' Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Joan Garcia, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
48' The attendance for today's match is 25003.
47' Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) serves up a nice cross, but Joan Garcia punches the ball away.
46' Bertug Yildirim will be replaced by Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe).
46' Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
43' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe).
39' 1 - 0 Marash Kumbulla (Espanyol) collects the ball deep inside the box from a rebound following the corner kick. He beats the keeper with a sharp shot into the top left corner. Brilliant goal!
39' The referee signals a corner kick to Espanyol.
38' Jofre (Espanyol) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
36' The ball possession at the moment is 68:32.
35' Luis Milla (Getafe) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
35' Ramon Terrats (Getafe) strikes a promising volley towards goal, but one of the defenders is quick enough to step in and make a crucial block.
34' A cross from a corner kick by Getafe is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
34' Ramon Terrats (Getafe) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the top right corner, but Joan Garcia reacts superbly to deny him.
32' Exposito (Espanyol) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post.
31' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) sends a teasing cross into the area, but David Soria intercepts the ball.
30' Espanyol can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
29' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Espanyol will take a corner kick.
28' The resulting corner, taken by Luis Milla (Getafe), comes to nothing.
26' Jofre (Espanyol) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.

25' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe). Ricardo De Burgos saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Espanyol, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
22' Ramon Terrats (Getafe) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Joan Garcia, who smothers the ball.
20' Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
19' Espanyol fail to score from a corner as David Soria (Getafe) leaps to collect the ball.
19' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes a short corner kick.
17' A great run by Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play and Getafe have been awarded a corner kick.

16' Ambitious effort from Jofre (Espanyol). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post.
14' Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
14' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes the corner but it's cleared.
12' Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

10' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.

10' Domingos Duarte (Getafe) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle for a foul. Espanyol are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
8' Exposito (Espanyol) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
6' A corner kick by Getafe is thwarted by the well prepared Joan Garcia (Espanyol).
5' Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Corner kick. Getafe will have an opportunity.
3' The linesman signals that Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

2' Espanyol slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
